To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

1) the best performance is obtained using a Support Vector Machines with a Gaussian kernel; 2) the preprocessing of deskewing the images improves the performance; 3) the preprocessing of blurring the images improves the performances; 4) the best features are obtained by using a combination of pixel intensity and histograms of gradients.

the best results are obtained by Support Vector Machines, that deskewing is a crucial preprocessing step, and that a combination of pixel values and gradient orientation histograms is the best set of features.

Support Vector Machines with a Gaussian kernel outperforms k-Nearest Neighbour and Random Forests classifiers in the recognition of handwritten digits, and that the best results are obtained by combining pixel intensities and histogram of orientations of gradients features, with deskewing and bluring preprocessings.
